title: High-Protein Peanut Butter Protein Balls
description: Quick no-bake snack made with wholesome ingredients and rolled into bite-sized portions. These protein bites deliver 11 grams of protein per serving and take just 10 minutes to prepare.
steps: In a large mixing bowl, combine 1 cup (90 g) rolled oats, 1/3 cup (35 g) vanilla protein powder, and 1 tbsp (12 g) chia seeds, stirring with a rubber spatula until evenly distributed.
Add 1/2 cup (128 g) creamy peanut butter and 1/3 cup (115 g) honey to the dry mixture, folding thoroughly for 2 minutes until a thick, sticky dough forms and no dry pockets remain.
Fold in 2 tbsp (20 g) mini semi-sweet chocolate chips gently until evenly dispersed throughout the dough.
Scoop out portions using a 1-tablespoon cookie scoop and roll firmly between your palms for 30 seconds each until smooth, cohesive balls are formed.
Transfer the finished balls to a parchment-lined baking sheet and refrigerate at 40°F (4°C) for 30 minutes until firm to the touch.
tips: If the mixture feels too dry or crumbly, add water one teaspoon at a time until it holds together.
Substitute almond butter or sunflower seed butter if you have a peanut allergy.
Roll the balls in shredded coconut or cocoa powder for added texture.
storage: Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 1 week or freeze for up to 2 months.

video_script.hook: Make these 12-gram protein peanut butter balls in just 10 minutes.
steps_short: Combine oats, protein powder, and chia seeds in a large bowl.
Stir in natural peanut butter and honey until thick.
Fold in mini chocolate chips gently.
Scoop and roll the mixture into firm balls.
Chill in the refrigerator until firm.
